node.statement: Choose the universal c0 witness of lem-maincb-error-improvement, then fix corresponding witnesses L^0 >= 1 and e_env^0 > 0 from lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope and C_s2^0 >= 1 and e_s2^0 > 0 from lem-maincb-stage2-extcb-datum. Set K_2^0 := max{1,e_s2^0/e_env^0}. Then K_2^0 is finite and universal, K_2^0 >= 1, and e_s2^0/K_2^0 <= e_env^0.
